## Definitions

- [statement] `SelectedEntity` is the selected entity’s change-event name; the Tooling API example for Account uses `AccountChangeEvent`. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation

## Structure and components

- [statement] SelectedEntity is the change-event name of the selected entity; FilterExpression contains a SOQL-based expression with a supported subset of operators and field types. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation

## How it works

- [statement] Attributed event-name conflict: the Omni guide’s Apex introductory prose says `AgentWorkPresenceChangeEvent`, while its Apex trigger declaration and channel-member XML use `AgentWorkChangeEvent`. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] Design inference, proposed capability step: call GetTopic for the candidate topic under the intended authentication context; compare returned topic_name and tenant_guid with the expected identity, record can_subscribe and can_publish separately, and retain schema_id and rpc_id. Treat a false subscription flag as a failed capability check, not as proof of a particular permission cause. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Pub/Sub error inspection exposes a gRPC status and description/details, a custom error code in exception trailers, and an RPC ID in the message and trailers. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] The documented topic error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.topic.meta.permission maps to PERMISSION_DENIED: An error occurred while getting the metadata for the specified topic. Ensure the credentials and topic name are correct. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] The documented topic error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.topic.not.found maps to NOT_FOUND: The topic information for the specified topic wasn’t found. Ensure that the topic name is correct and the topic exists. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] The documented topic error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.topic.api.unavailable maps to UNAVAILABLE: The topic information is unavailable for the specified topic. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] The documented topic error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.topic.validation.empty maps to INVALID_ARGUMENT: An error occurred while validating the topic information provided. The topic can’t be blank. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: on topic-lookup failure, preserve the gRPC status, custom error code, and RPC ID; classify blank input, missing topic, metadata-permission failure, and unavailable information separately. Correct or investigate the indicated cause before repeating the lookup; a failure does not justify rewriting the configured topic automatically. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html
- [statement] Design inference, proposed error-handling step: record status, custom trailer error code, and RPC ID. On topic metadata permission failure, recheck both credentials and topic name; on not-found, recheck the name and existence; on empty-topic validation failure, fix the input; on unavailable-topic information, classify validation as inconclusive and retry under an operational retry policy. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html
- [statement] The subscription error sfdc.platform.eventbus.grpc.subscription.topic.cannot.subscribe maps to PERMISSION_DENIED and directs the caller to check required permissions. (low confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/guide/handling-errors.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Attributed naming conflict: the Omni guide gives the subscription setting /data/ExternalRoutingChannel_chn, while its member XML uses ExternalRoutingChannel__chn and the CDC subscription guide specifies /data/ChannelName__chn. Preserve these spellings as source positions rather than silently correcting the Omni text. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: inspect each associated member individually for `SelectedEntity`, `FilterExpression`, `FullName`, and `Metadata`; compare the selected entities and predicates with the intended contract. When the Omni sample is the contract, retain its literal presence predicate rather than rewriting OR as AND. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html
- [statement] Design inference, proposed identity step: form the candidate topic by prefixing the retrieved channel FullName with /data/, retaining its namespace and __chn suffix. Record the Omni single-underscore subscription spelling as a discrepancy to resolve, rather than deriving a topic from the member DeveloperName. (medium confidence) — https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannelmember.html, https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html, https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/service/service-presence-developer-guide/guide/omnichannel-external-routing-subscribe-to-change-data-capture-event-notificat.html

- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: use an explicitly identified intended org and principal for the metadata reads and the authenticated topic lookup, and record that context with the comparison; no target-org execution is implied by this proposal. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/api-tooling/references/tooling-objects/tooling-platformeventchannel.html
- [statement] TopicInfo defines topic_name, tenant_guid, can_publish, can_subscribe, schema_id, and rpc_id. The protocol describes can_publish as whether publishing is allowed and can_subscribe as whether subscription is allowed. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation
- [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: compare returned `topic_name` with the requested topic, record `tenant_guid`, and require `can_subscribe` before considering the subscription-capability check successful. Record `can_publish` separately without making publishing a prerequisite for this read-only procedure. - [statement] Proposed read-only procedure, design inference: record `schema_id` and `rpc_id`; optionally use the returned schema ID for a schema-information lookup as a separate diagnostic step. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html
- [statement] Design inference, verification boundary: successful topic-information lookup and capability inspection establish only the returned metadata and flags in that authentication context. They do not establish actual event delivery or filter-predicate correctness; assess delivery separately with an explicitly authorized subscription and representative events. This proposed procedure ends after read-only metadata/RPC checks and makes no target-org assertion. (medium confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forcedotcom/pub-sub-api/main/pubsub_api.proto · keywords: Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation · also: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/pub-sub-api/references/methods/gettopic-rpc.html, https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/platform/change-data-capture/guide/cdc-filter-subscribe.html, https://www.outofmemo.com/articles/salesforce-create-filtered-cdc-channel-platformeventchannel

## Research summary — Salesforce Omni-Channel CDC channel configuration and topic validation

Salesforce’s Omni-Channel example configures a CDC channel and filtered channel members. Its presence example retains an OR predicate and parentheses. This probe preserves attributed naming conflicts and proposes a read-only verification procedure: inspect channel identity and member metadata, derive the CDC topic from the full channel name, then inspect GetTopic identity and capability fields and classify explicit topic errors. The procedure is a design inference from the cited API definitions. Topic-information success does not establish event delivery or predicate correctness.

Gate verdict: `SUPPORTED`. Auxiliary assertion: `prose:52d573ef55699ab93c79fdd5de47d37b3ace5a05919dbf90b919a4b53102250c`. Statement hash: `52d573ef55699ab93c79fdd5de47d37b3ace5a05919dbf90b919a4b53102250c`.
